description: Browser IndexedDB-backed offline store for document editor drafts. Persists unsaved edits locally so they survive a reload or a lost connection, and can be replayed once the backend is reachable again. Requires a JS runtime, so it only works in an interactive (WASM or Server) render mode.

members.name: IndexedDbDocumentOfflineStore
members.description: Creates the store on top of the browser's IndexedDB via JS interop.

members.type: Task SaveDraftAsync(DocumentOfflineDraft draft, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

members.name: LoadDraftAsync
members.type: Task<DocumentOfflineDraft?> LoadDraftAsync(string draftId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
members.description: Reads a single draft, or null when it is not stored.

members.type: Task DeleteDraftAsync(string draftId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
members.description: Removes a draft, typically after it has been synced to the server.

members.description: Lists every draft still awaiting synchronisation.
